project:
The player whose suit matches the central tile takes the next turn. If a player draws the [icon=whitedragon] tile, they play again.

Tap the [icon=placement] icon to choose which column to place your next tile in. Tiles in that column are pushed back, and the tile pushed out at the end is revealed as the new central tile for the next turn.

If the [icon=whitedragon] tile ends up on your board, you must discard it, as it cannot be grouped with any other tiles.

Objective: complete 9 columns, each with 4 matching tiles.
